description: Adopt your own W2 candidate proposal for the bound Goal. decisionRefs are supplied by the platform. Pass acknowledgementRef only when the user answered a card for this candidate; the plan owner re-reads that formal answer and derives the decision source itself. Only a real committed plan revision is reported as success.

parameters.proposalRef: Your own candidate_v2 proposal ref; the plan service refuses another Run/author candidate.
parameters.expectedProposalRevision: The exact revision of proposalRef, as read.
parameters.expected: The exact W1 version pins the caller saw; omit a pin rather than guessing a fresh revision.
parameters.acknowledgementRef: The user answer message this adoption is attributed to, when the user answered a card for this candidate. Attribution only; the plan owner re-reads the formal answer and derives the decision source itself. Omit it when the adoption is not attributed to a user answer.
